name: ManuscriptAcquisitionPipeline
tagline: From slush pile to print run – submissions, board P&L, offers, contracts, production schedule and reprints in one drop-in Power Apps app.
description: A complete book-acquisitions module for publishers: log and read submissions, take titles to the editorial board with a live P&L and margin gate, make offers and contract, track manuscript delivery and back-scheduled production milestones, and plan print runs and reprints by imprint. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen or model-driven form and connects to any collection, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL table through column dropdowns.
features: Stage rules with blocked-move reasons and undo
Acquisition P&L: net receipt, sell-through, contribution, margin, earn-out, break-even
Print runs and P&L by imprint
Board pack, reprint and manuscript-chase actions for Power Fx
Bulk advance / hold / decline / delete, CSV export
Configurable stage labels, imprints, colours, currency and assumptions
Phone layout with bottom view bar
